exposure: ulipristal acetate (UPA) 5 mg/day for three months
intramural fibroids not distorting the uterine cavity
outcome: IVF outcome (positivity of beta human chorionic gonadotropin - hCG)
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 23 women with symptomatic uterine fibroids followed in an assisted reproduction center, with a subset of 13 undergoing ART compared to a control group of ART patients without fibroids.
finding: Ulipristal acetate treatment significantly reduced fibroid volume, improved symptoms, and reduced uterine cavity distortion in women with uterine fibroids, with subsequent IVF outcomes (hCG positivity) being similar to a control group of ART patients without fibroids.
